title: Register a doctor
summary: Creates the physician's or dentist's user. They get an email to choose their password.

steps.title: New doctor
steps.details: Opens the new doctor form. The doctor limit depends on your license.

steps.title: First and last name
steps.details: It's the name patients see in reminders and on the portal.

steps.title: Email
steps.details: It will be their username to sign in to Invoke and they get an email to choose their password. It can't be the same as another user's.
steps.description: It's their username to sign in to Invoke. It has to be unique.

steps.title: Phone
steps.details: Optional: used for internal notices to the doctor.

steps.title: ID
steps.details: Optional: it shows on prescriptions and instructions if you enter it.

steps.title: Create the doctor
steps.details: Creates the doctor. For them to show on the calendar their availability still has to be entered.
